credit: Generated by splitting housing.json in two. The block turns in 22.5 degree steps, which a blockstate cannot express: its y is limited to quarter turns, the 22.5 that would make up the difference cannot be an element rotation because these elements already rotate about z and an element gets one rotation, and it cannot be baked into coordinates either because a 22.5 degree turn does not leave an axis aligned box axis aligned. So the head is drawn by the block entity renderer at whichever of the sixteen angles it is turned to. The mast is everything whose footprint lies inside the central column, x and z both within 6.5 to 9.5: the pole and the collars around it, which stay square with the world however far the head is turned. Edit housing.json and regenerate; never by hand. This is the mast.
